snippet.title: [Amstrad CPC] Daley Thompson's Super Test - Longplay
snippet.description:
Daley Thompson's Super Test
© Ocean Software (1985)

Have you got the concentration for Pistol Shooting, the grace of a Springboard Diver, stamina for Cycling and Rowing or sheer muscle for the Tug O'War? Could you develop the speed and timing of Giant Slalom and Ski Jumping or the accuracy and pace of a centre forward? Two full days of events in this giant sports extravaganza. 

Daley Thompson's Decathlon (1985) : https://youtu.be/DYPffEouX40?si=fFZtjPGGktwd8ftF
Daley Thompson's Super Test (1985) : https://youtu.be/Oe4w8LmWBaI?si=ha5vhMinscEEurnD

0:00 Intro
1:08 Pistol Shoot
4:12 Cycling
5:27 Diving
7:18 Giant Slalom
10:58 Rowing
11:51 Penalties
13:29 Ski Jump
15:44 Tug O'War
17:06 End
